French

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]
Etymology tree
Proto-Indo-European *meh₁-
Proto-Italic *mētis
Latin mētior
Proto-Indo-European *-tew-?
Proto-Indo-European *-r-eh₂?
Latin -tūra
Latin mēnsūra
Proto-Indo-European *-h₂
Proto-Indo-European *-éh₂
Proto-Indo-European *-yéti
Proto-Indo-European *-eh₂yéti
Proto-Italic *-āō
Latin -ō
Late Latin mēnsūrāre
Old French mesurer
French mesurer

    Inherited from Old French mesurer, from Late Latin mēnsūrāre, from Latin mēnsūra.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /mə.zy.ʁe/
    • Audio:(file)
    • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
    • Audio (France (Lyon)):(file)
    • Audio (France (Somain)):(file)

    Verb

    [edit]

    mesurer

    1. (intransitive) to measure
      Il mesure 1,81 mètres
      He measures 1.81 metres
    2. (transitive) to measure

    Etymology

    [edit]

      Inherited from Late Latin mēnsūrāre.

      Verb

      [edit]

      mesurer

      1. (transitive) to measure

      Conjugation

      [edit]

      This verb conjugates as a first-group verb ending in -er. Old French conjugation varies significantly by date and by region. The following conjugation should be treated as a guide.
